title: Sum of Variable Length Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array nums of size n, for each index i, calculate the subarray starting at max(0, i - nums[i]) and ending at i.
statement: Given an integer array nums of size n, for each index i, calculate the subarray starting at max(0, i - nums[i]) and ending at i. Sum all elements of these subarrays.
constraints: For every index i, form the subarray from max(0,i-nums[i]) through i inclusive.
Add the sums of all these variable-length subarrays.
An element may contribute to several subarrays.
hints: Build prefix sums so any subarray sum is a difference of two prefixes.
For index i, clamp its requested start to zero.
Subtract the prefix before that start from the prefix through i.
Summing these exact contributions gives the requested total.
editorial: Summing these exact contributions gives the requested total.

tests.explanation: The chosen subarrays are [2], [2,3], and [3,1], whose sums total eleven.
The subarrays are [0], [0,1], and [0], totaling one.
